annotations.title: Publish a message to a channel

description: WRITE: publish a message to a channel. Every connected subscriber receives it in real time. This is a real, outward-facing side effect — confirm the channel and payload before calling. REST: POST /channels/{channel}/messages.

channel.description: Channel name to publish to, e.g. 'chat:room1'.

clientId.description: Optional clientId to attribute the message to.

data.description: Message payload (string; send JSON as a stringified value).

name.description: Optional event name for the message.

name: ably_publish_message
title: Publish a message to a channel
